changelog.summary: Desktop 0.8.0-beta.2: guided migration, durable preparation, safe continuation, project backup/restore and DEB compatibility. Publisher 0.8.0-beta.1 and Generic CMS 0.9.0-beta.1 are unchanged.

desktop.changelog: Runtime-accepted guided desktop beta.2, built from clean committed source for the v0.8.0-beta.4 public beta release.

publisher.changelog: Unchanged from the approved beta.1 Publisher Q-App.

cms.changelog: Generic CMS 0.9.0-beta.1: reusable template system with Default, Magazine / News, Portfolio, Documentation / Knowledge Base, Photography / Gallery, Business / Services, Video / Media and Personal Journal. Templates are selected in Appearance settings; content, publishing and owner controls are shared.
